Problem: Tony has a bucket that holds 2 pounds of sand. He has a sandbox out back that is two feet deep, four feet wide, and 5 feet long. A cubic foot of sand weighs 3 pounds. Because it's hot outside, he wants to make sure he stays hydrated, so every 4 trips he takes he drinks 3 ounces of bottled water. A 15 ounce bottle of water costs $2. He has $10 with him. sandbox.depth_feet = 2
sandbox.width_feet = 4
sandbox.length_feet = 5

bottled_water.bottle_ounces = 15
bottled_water.bottle_cost_dollars = 2
tony.cash_dollars = 10
sandbox.volume_cubic_feet = sandbox.depth_feet * sandbox.width_feet * sandbox.length_feet
sandbox.sand_pounds = sandbox.volume_cubic_feet * sand.weight_per_cubic_foot_pounds
